notes.title: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars Playable at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.content:
HARUKA: Beyond the Stars will be available to play at Tokyo Game Show 2025, taking place at Makuhari Messe from 9/25 through 9/28! It will be shown at the SELECTED INDIE 80 (E-56) booth.
 
 The first of thirteen chapters can be played in the demo version. Enjoy the encounter between Yuuki and Miiya, and the battle system in which players switch between the two characters depending on the boss faced.
 
 Drop by our booth and take a photo with Mukumuku, upload it to social media, and receive an original present!
 
 We hope to see you there.

notes.title: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars to be Published by PLAYISM!
notes.content:
PLAYISM is proud to announce that we will be publishing HARUKA: Beyond the Stars, the upcoming sci-fi coming-of-age action RPG by the indie development team atelier mimina.

HARUKA: Beyond the Stars is a coming-of-age sci-fi action RPG which follows the protagonist Yuuki and the mysterious girl Miiya on their journey across space. Ride on a spaceship to visit and explore various unique planets, and enjoy an exciting adventure depicted in an anime style with the latest CG technology.

[previewyoutube=H7-Ujvz3Ue4;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is slated for a 2026 release, so please wishlist the game and look forward to more announcements!
